findings.claim: Every one of the eight anomalies is present in saved raw HTML, with the same account, course ID and topic ID before/after; no matching or color-parsing error was found.

All six decreases are 3/5-correct legacy reviews (five foundations, one differential). Every decreased target oscillates in nearby snapshots; foundations task14096422 also has72 falls among83 changed targets.

Per-question error penalties are possible, but these saved observations do not isolate them. Errors occur in both falling and nonfalling reviews and the same targets move down after unrelated activities.

The two perfect1→6 reviews are3/3-correct current-pipeline reviews, have no earlier captured direct target practice, and show no unrelated background movement. Their long-spacing multiplier cannot be measured because target-practice age is unknown.

Timing-magnitude is an ordinal palette record. Numeric repetition thresholds or a special default/categorical darkest color remain unresolved, so a five-index jump is not established as five repetitions.

Use a calibrated signed display/background residual and an unknown-initial-state/high-gain component. Preserve the anomalies in validation and score sensitivity; do not let encompassing weights compensate for them.

decreases.cause: Recalculation of a displayed mastery/ability value, including shared updates across topics.
decreases.reason: The same targets repeatedly reverse within minutes during other activities; one decrease accompanies72 falling targets.
decreases.implementation: Give signed display recalculation its own residual component and keep it out of encompassing weights.

decreases.cause: Per-question penalties or ability adjustments triggered by incorrect answers.
decreases.reason: All six tasks contain two mistakes, but the same3/5 outcome generally does not fall and target reversals also occur during unrelated activities.
decreases.implementation: Treat mistakes as part of performance-sensitive response; do not subtract a fixed inferred repetition penalty from every mistake.

decreases.reason: Possible in a distributed UI, but the audit found internally consistent saved rows and no demonstrated stale pairing.
decreases.implementation: Keep an observation residual; no capture repair is justified by this evidence.

perfect_one_to_six.cause: Large quality/ability-sensitive progress on an already-known reviewed topic, mapped to the darkest display category.
perfect_one_to_six.reason: Both tasks complete after three correct answers, with no unrelated background changes, and neither has a known earlier direct-practice timestamp in the captured window.
perfect_one_to_six.implementation: Use the fitted positive-dose response plus a high-gain/unknown-state tail. Do not force these observations to select a long-spacing coefficient.
